name: Dependent (Family) Visa

requirements.blocker_text: Spouse, unmarried child under 21 (with exceptions for unmarried adult daughters, e.g. while studying), or dependent parent under stricter conditions.
Sponsor's monthly salary must reach BHD 400 to sponsor a spouse and children (higher, commonly reported around BHD 800+, for sponsoring parents).

outcome.duration_length: 1 year, annually renewable, contingent on the sponsor's continued status

sources.title: Fakhoury Global Immigration (law firm) -- Bahrain minimum salary increase for dependent sponsorship: BHD 400/month for spouse and children (raised from BHD 250 per a 2018 alert), higher threshold reported for sponsoring parents
